flags.model_excerpt: ಇವಾಗ ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಕಾಲ್ ಗೆ 500 ಪೇ ಮಾಡಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಹೊತ್ತು ಬೇಕು ಅಷ್ಟು ಹೊತ್ತು ಟೈಮ್ ಲಿಮಿಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲ ತೋರಿಸ್ತೀನಿ
flags.model_translation: Now pay 500 for a video call and for as long as you want there is no time limit, I will show
flags.model_justification: The user directly offers payment tied to showing and time, constituting a severe violation.
flags.model_context: The user offers to pay 500 for an unlimited video call where they will 'show', which violates the suspicious activity policy regarding payments tied to showing.
